title: Barefoot Bliss – Stay on 30A
description_expanded: class="property_description"> Welcome to 'Barefoot Bliss,'  where elegant design meets exquisite Gulf-front location! Located in a highly sought-after Dune Allen Beach community, Barefoot Bliss is a 6-bedroom, 7-bathroom luxury home that sleeps 14 comfortably. With stunning emerald water views from the private pool and direct access to the beach, this home perfectly embodies 30A living! The ground level of this home offers on-site parking for 4 vehicles in the driveway, as well as the convenience of a bathroom and laundry room. Additionally, the laundry room has one set of twin over twin bunk beds. Upon entering this 4-story residence, guests will find a bright great room, aglow with sunshine from the stunning Gulf-front views. An inviting living area offers plush seating around a 75” TV, while a nearby sitting room provides additional comforts with a queen sleeper sofa—ideal for last-minute visitors. Guests can easily prepare cocktails with a wine fridge and ice maker at the wet bar before sitting at the 10-seat dining table for a home-cooked meal. The pristine white kitchen, featuring a stunning marble island with a built-in sink, is fully equipped with high-end Thermador appliances, making it easy to host large groups. Enjoy access to the spacious outdoor deck from anywhere in the great room—swim in the private pool with a built-in sitting spa, relax on 4 cozy loungers, or grill up some snacks in the outdoor kitchen. Guests can use the stairs or in-home elevator to access the top floors of this home. The third floor offers 3 stylish guest bedrooms with great views, each boasting access to a rear balcony overlooking the pool. Just down the hallway is a wet bar with an ice maker and mini-fridge, as well as a stacked washer and dryer for convenience. The fourth floor offers similar accommodations—a wet bar with an ice maker and mini-fridge, as well as another closet with a stacked washer and dryer. There are 2 comfortable guest bedrooms with access to a rear balcony overlooking beautiful Gulf waters. Both the third and fourth floor wet bars are stocked with a Keurig machine for the early risers! This beachfront property provides incredible amenities and spectacular views, as well as being a prime location for exploring local shops and restaurants. With 8 adult bikes—plus a 6-passenger golf cart—getting around has never been easier. Experience the ultimate relaxation and convenience at Barefoot Bliss!  HOME HIGHLIGHTS: -Steps from the beach -Gulf front with spectacular views  -Private pool with Sitting Spa **Pool heating available for $50 per day** -Complimentary beach setups each morning include 8 beach chairs with 4 umbrellas (Mar 1 2025-Feb 28 2026) -6 Passenger golf cart -8 adult bikes -Elevator -Travel Crib and highchair provided -One step from the sand from back door PARKING: Four driveway parking spaces available. No garage access. Included is a 6 seater golf cart and 8 bicycles (adult) for your convenience. To drive golf cart, you must be: 25 years old, sign a liability waiver, and have valid insurance and drivers license. Golf Cart is included as an amenity, at no additional cost. ACCOMMODATIONS: Sleeps: 14   FIRST FLOOR: -Bedroom #1: Twin over Twin Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only SECOND FLOOR: -Bedroom/Living Combo: Queen Sleeper Sofa, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only THIRD FLOOR: -Bedroom #2: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only -Bedroom #3: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo -Bedroom #4: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only FOURTH FLOOR: -Bedroom #5: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate -Bedroom #6: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | WELCOME BUNDLE: Coffee Grounds | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises. *No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including back porch/deck.  *No parties or events.  *Complimentary golf cart can only be operated by guests over 25 years of age who provide verification. Rental agreement requires a valid drivers license and proof of existing auto insurance coverage. *During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi. *Private Heated Pool With Spa **Pool heating is available for an additional fee of $50/day. Pool & spa are heated together. Must be heated for duration of stay.  If selected, it must be requested 48 hours prior to check in and paid before the heater will be turned on. IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver’s license and 2) a "selfie". Both should be uploaded to our Happy Stays app. Please note, the garage is not for guest use. read more + less -
